No temp tables (`SELECT INTO` is a write). I'll do it in a single query with CTEs. Since ~104K patients is manageable, I'll assign each patient one indication (priority-ordered) from the pre-index window, then count SSRI-typical adverse events in the post-index window, and rank side effects within each indication.

Let me run the combined analysis in one CTE query, restricting side effects to a curated SSRI adverse-event concept set to keep it fast.

arguments.sql_query:
WITH idx AS (
  SELECT de.person_id, MIN(de.drug_exposure_start_date) AS idx_date
  FROM omop.drug_exposure de
  JOIN omop.concept_ancestor ca ON ca.descendant_concept_id = de.drug_concept_id AND ca.ancestor_concept_id IN (797617,715939,755695,751412,722031,739138)
  GROUP BY de.person_id
),
ind AS (
  SELECT i.person_id,
    MAX(CASE WHEN ca.ancestor_concept_id=440383 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS depression,
    MAX(CASE WHEN ca.ancestor_concept_id=442077 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS anxiety,
    MAX(CASE WHEN ca.ancestor_concept_id=436676 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ptsd,
    MAX(CASE WHEN ca.ancestor_concept_id=440374 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ocd,
    MAX(CASE WHEN ca.ancestor_concept_id=436074 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS panic
  FROM idx i
  JOIN omop.condition_occurrence co ON co.person_id=i.person_id
    AND co.condition_start_date BETWEEN DATEADD(day,-90,i.idx_date) AND DATEADD(day,14,i.idx_date)
  JOIN omop.concept_ancestor ca ON ca.descendant_concept_id=co.condition_concept_id
    AND ca.ancestor_concept_id IN (440383,442077,436676,440374,436074)
  GROUP BY i.person_id
)
SELECT
  SUM(depression) AS depression, SUM(anxiety) AS anxiety, SUM(ptsd) AS ptsd,
  SUM(ocd) AS ocd, SUM(panic) AS panic, COUNT(*) AS any_indication
FROM ind

arguments.sql_query:
WITH idx AS (
  SELECT de.person_id, MIN(de.drug_exposure_start_date) AS idx_date
  FROM omop.drug_exposure de
  JOIN omop.concept_ancestor ca ON ca.descendant_concept_id = de.drug_concept_id AND ca.ancestor_concept_id IN (797617,715939,755695,751412,722031,739138)
  GROUP BY de.person_id
),
ind AS (
  SELECT i.person_id, i.idx_date,
    CASE
      WHEN MAX(CASE WHEN ca.ancestor_concept_id=436676 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)=1 THEN 'PTSD'
      WHEN MAX(CASE WHEN ca.ancestor_concept_id=440374 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)=1 THEN 'OCD'
      WHEN MAX(CASE WHEN ca.ancestor_concept_id=436074 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)=1 THEN 'Panic disorder'
      WHEN MAX(CASE WHEN ca.ancestor_concept_id=440383 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)=1 THEN 'Depression'
      WHEN MAX(CASE WHEN ca.ancestor_concept_id=442077 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)=1 THEN 'Anxiety'
    END AS indication
  FROM idx i
  JOIN omop.condition_occurrence co ON co.person_id=i.person_id
    AND co.condition_start_date BETWEEN DATEADD(day,-90,i.idx_date) AND DATEADD(day,14,i.idx_date)
  JOIN omop.concept_ancestor ca ON ca.descendant_concept_id=co.condition_concept_id
    AND ca.ancestor_concept_id IN (440383,442077,436676,440374,436074)
  GROUP BY i.person_id, i.idx_date
),
ae AS (
  SELECT ind.person_id, ind.indication, se.concept_id AS ae_id
  FROM ind
  JOIN omop.condition_occurrence co ON co.person_id=ind.person_id
    AND co.condition_start_date BETWEEN DATEADD(day,15,ind.idx_date) AND DATEADD(day,365,ind.idx_date)
  JOIN omop.concept_ancestor ca2 ON ca2.descendant_concept_id=co.condition_concept_id
  JOIN (VALUES (31967),(27674),(441408),(378253),(436962),(4223938),(196523),(441542),
        (443782),(75860),(138565),(4203638),(4232311),(4273391),(4012381),(315078),
        (44790749),(3655355)) AS se(concept_id) ON se.concept_id=ca2.ancestor_concept_id
  WHERE ind.indication IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY ind.person_id, ind.indication, se.concept_id
)
SELECT ae.indication, c.concept_name AS side_effect,
  COUNT(DISTINCT ae.person_id) AS n_with_ae
FROM ae JOIN omop.concept c ON c.concept_id=ae.ae_id
GROUP BY ae.indication, c.concept_name
ORDER BY ae.indication, n_with_ae DESC

),

  SELECT i.person_id, i.idx_date,
    CASE
      WHEN MAX(CASE WHEN ca.ancestor_concept_id=436676 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)=1 THEN 'PTSD'
      WHEN MAX(CASE WHEN ca.ancestor_concept_id=440374 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)=1 THEN 'OCD'
      WHEN MAX(CASE WHEN ca.ancestor_concept_id=436074 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)=1 THEN 'Panic disorder'
      WHEN MAX(CASE WHEN ca.ancestor_concept_id=440383 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)=1 THEN 'Depression'
      WHEN MAX(CASE WHEN ca.ancestor_concept_id=442077 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)=1 THEN 'Anxiety'
    END AS indication
  FROM idx i
  JOIN omop.condition_occurrence co ON co.person_id=i.person_id
    AND co.condition_start_date BETWEEN DATEADD(day,-90,i.idx_date) AND DATEADD(day,14,i.idx_date)
  JOIN omop.concept_ancestor ca ON ca.descendant_concept_id=co.condition_concept_id
    AND ca.ancestor_concept_id IN (440383,442077,436676,440374,436074)
  GROUP BY i.person_id, i.idx_date
),
denom AS (
  SELECT indication, COUNT(*) AS n_patients FROM ind WHERE indication IS NOT NULL GROUP BY indication
),
ae AS (
  SELECT ind.indication, co.condition_concept_id AS ae_id, COUNT(DISTINCT ind.person_id) AS n_ae
  FROM ind
  JOIN omop.condition_occurrence co ON co.person_id=ind.person_id
    AND co.condition_start_date BETWEEN DATEADD(day,15,ind.idx_date) AND DATEADD(day,365,ind.idx_date)

content.text:
The three failures are all "Transport closed" — a server-side timeout/OOM from queries that recompute the heavy `idx` + pre-index condition join twice or scan the post-index window over all 42K patients at once. The two-CTE version (`idx`→`ind`) is itself too expensive to materialize repeatedly.

What I'll change: stop re-deriving the whole cohort per query. Instead, narrow the `idx` CTE by joining conditions directly to first-exposure without the full ancestor expansion where possible, and compute **one indication at a time** with a tight filter so the server only touches that subgroup. Let me start with the smallest indication group (OCD) to confirm the shape works before scaling up.

arguments.sql_query:
SELECT co.condition_concept_id, c.concept_name, COUNT(DISTINCT sub.person_id) AS n_ae, COUNT(DISTINCT sub.person_id) AS dummy
FROM (
  SELECT i.person_id, i.idx_date
  FROM (
    SELECT de.person_id, MIN(de.drug_exposure_start_date) AS idx_date
    FROM omop.drug_exposure de
    JOIN omop.concept_ancestor ca ON ca.descendant_concept_id = de.drug_concept_id AND ca.ancestor_concept_id IN (797617,715939,755695,751412,722031,739138)
    GROUP BY de.person_id
  ) i
  WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM omop.condition_occurrence co2
    JOIN omop.concept_ancestor ca2 ON ca2.descendant_concept_id=co2.condition_concept_id AND ca2.ancestor_concept_id=440374
    WHERE co2.person_id=i.person_id AND co2.condition_start_date BETWEEN DATEADD(day,-90,i.idx_date) AND DATEADD(day,14,i.idx_date)
  )
